steps.note: the API built this case's state
Ensure the Withdraw option is available on the event.
Ensure eRFX project events are enabled for the tenant.
Verify the project menu offers an enabled withdrawal action before withdrawing.
Withdraw the upcoming project with the required audit reason.
Assert that Procol records the event as withdrawn.
Open the activity drawer to inspect the withdrawal audit record.
Verify the withdrawal reason is recorded in Order Activity.
Open the History tab where withdrawn events should appear.
Assert that the withdrawn upcoming RFQ appears in History.
Verify the event row shows the Withdrawn status.
Inspect the invited vendor's view after the buyer withdraws the event.
Open the withdrawn event in the supplier portal overview.
Verify vendors see the event as withdrawn and cannot bid.
